verdict.rationale: Fly.io explicitly documents that a Sprite's disk 'grows as you write it, up to 100 GB per Sprite, and you're only billed for the bytes you actually put there,' directly matching the story's pay-for-bytes-written claim. However this applies specifically to the newer 'Sprites' product, not clearly to general Fly Machines volumes, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the billing behavior. Missing for 10: confirmation this applies to standard persistent volumes (not just Sprites), third-party verification of actual billing behavior, and details on billing rate/mechanics.
